import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExercisePolicies
import androidx.datastore.core.Serializer
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ActivityEvent
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ActivityEventType
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.BudgetPeriod
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.CorrectionEvent
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.DailyCounter
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.DailyUsageReport
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.DEFAULT_SESSION_MINUTES
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.EMERGENCY_SKIP_DAILY_LIMIT
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ForegroundClass
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.MAX_DAILY_CREDITED_EXERCISE_VERIFICATIONS
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.MAX_SESSION_MINUTES
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.MAX_SAFE_BUDGET_ROUNDS
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.MIN_SESSION_MINUTES
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.MonthlyPushupCycle
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.PendingWait
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.OffUsageReminderState
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.PersistedState
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.EXERCISE_POINT_SIXTHS_PER_BOOST
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RESTRICTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RestrictionEngine
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RestrictorSettings
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RuntimeMetadata
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.SPRINT_SET_QUALIFYING_METERS
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ThemePreference
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.UnlockSession
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.UnlockSource
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.UsagePeriodState
import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.EOFException
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream

object AppStateSerializer : Serializer<PersistedState> {
    private const val MAGIC = 0x49525354 // IRST

    override val defaultValue: PersistedState = PersistedState()

    override suspend fun readFrom(input: InputStream): PersistedState {
        try {
            val source = DataInputStream(input)
            if (source.readInt() != MAGIC) throw CorruptionException("Unrecognized state file")
            val schema = source.readInt()
            if (schema !in 1..RESTRICTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
                throw CorruptionException("Unsupported state schema: $schema")
            }
            val revision = source.readLong()
            source.readBoolean() // Retired enforcement toggle. Protection is always on.
            if (schema >= 2 && source.readBoolean()) source.readLong() // Retired pause end.
            source.readBoolean() // Retired wait toggle. The focused wait is always required.
            if (schema <= 2) {
                // Legacy builds stored configurable daily, weekly, and monthly limits.
                repeat(3) {
                    source.readBoolean()
                    source.readLong()
                }
            }
            source.readBoolean() // Retired emergency-skip toggle. Skips are always enabled.
            source.readLong() // Retired configurable emergency-skip limit.
            val theme = source.readEnum<ThemePreference>()
            val onboardingCompleted = source.readBoolean()
            val sessionMinutes = if (schema >= 4) {
                val count = source.readInt()
                if (count != DEFAULT_SESSION_MINUTES.size) {
                    throw CorruptionException("Invalid session preset count")
                }
                List(count) { source.readLong() }
            } else {
                DEFAULT_SESSION_MINUTES
            }
            val settings = RestrictorSettings(
                enforcementEnabled = true,
                pauseUntilWallMs = null,
                delayEnabled = true,
                emergencySkipsEnabled = true,
                emergencySkipDailyLimit = EMERGENCY_SKIP_DAILY_LIMIT,
                theme = theme,
                onboardingCompleted = onboardingCompleted,
                sessionMinutes = sessionMinutes,
            )
            val daily = source.readUsage(BudgetPeriod.DAILY)
            if (schema <= 2) {
                // Consume the retired weekly and monthly usage records.
                source.readUTF()
                source.readLong()
                source.readUTF()
                source.readLong()
            }
            val unlock = if (source.readBoolean()) {
                val id = source.readUTF()
                val sourceOrdinal = source.readInt()
                val grantedAtWallMs = source.readLong()
                val expiresAtWallMs = source.readLong()
                val unlockSource = UnlockSource.entries.getOrNull(sourceOrdinal)
                if (schema <= 2 && sourceOrdinal == 2) {
                    // A legacy push-up unlock is deliberately not migrated into earned budget.
                    null
                } else {
                    UnlockSession(
                        id = id,
                        source = unlockSource
                            ?: throw CorruptionException("Invalid unlock source"),
                        grantedAtWallMs = grantedAtWallMs,
                        expiresAtWallMs = expiresAtWallMs,
                    )
                }
            } else null
            val pending = if (source.readBoolean()) {
                val storedPending = PendingWait(
                    id = source.readUTF(),
                    selectedDurationMs = source.readLong(),
                    requiredFocusMs = source.readLong(),
                    accumulatedFocusMs = source.readLong(),
                    createdAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                    updatedAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                )
                if (schema <= 2) {
                    // Legacy waits used the retired escalating formula. Restart at the fixed
                    // 12-second gate instead of carrying an incompatible partial wait forward.
                    null
                } else {
                    storedPending
                }
            } else null
            val localDayKey = source.readUTF()
            val earnedBudgetRounds = if (schema >= 3) {
                source.readLong()
            } else {
                source.readLong() // Retired completed-normal-unlock count.
                0L
            }
            val emergencySkipsUsed = source.readLong()
            val pushupRepetitionRemainder = if (schema >= 7) source.readLong() else 0L
            val spendableBudgetRounds = if (schema >= 8) source.readLong() else earnedBudgetRounds
            val eveningResetApplied = if (schema >= 8) source.readBoolean() else false
            val verifiedPushups: Long
            val plankSecondRemainder: Long
            val machineRepetitionRemainder: Long
            val creditedExerciseVerificationIds: List<String>
            if (schema >= 10) {
                verifiedPushups = source.readLong()
                plankSecondRemainder = source.readLong()
                machineRepetitionRemainder = source.readLong()
                val creditedVerificationCount = source.readInt()
                if (creditedVerificationCount !in 0..MAX_DAILY_CREDITED_EXERCISE_VERIFICATIONS) {
                    throw CorruptionException("Invalid credited exercise verification count")
                }
                creditedExerciseVerificationIds = List(creditedVerificationCount) { source.readUTF() }
            } else {
                verifiedPushups = Math.addExact(
                    Math.multiplyExact(earnedBudgetRounds, 5L), // Historical schemas used five push-ups per set.
                    pushupRepetitionRemainder,
                )
                plankSecondRemainder = 0L
                machineRepetitionRemainder = 0L
                creditedExerciseVerificationIds = emptyList()
            }
            val counter = DailyCounter(
                localDayKey = localDayKey,
                exercisePointSixths = if (schema >= 11) source.readLong() else 0L,
                earnedBudgetRounds = earnedBudgetRounds,
                emergencySkipsUsed = emergencySkipsUsed,
                pushupRepetitionRemainder = pushupRepetitionRemainder,
                spendableBudgetRounds = spendableBudgetRounds,
                eveningResetApplied = eveningResetApplied,
                plankSecondRemainder = plankSecondRemainder,
                machineRepetitionRemainder = machineRepetitionRemainder,
                verifiedPushups = verifiedPushups,
                creditedExerciseVerificationIds = creditedExerciseVerificationIds,
                sprintMetersRemainder = if (schema >= 12) source.readLong() else 0L,
            )
            val metadata = RuntimeMetadata(
                lastCommittedWallMs = source.readLong(),
                recoveryEpochId = source.readUTF(),
                serviceLastConnectedWallMs = source.readLong(),
                lastKnownForegroundClass = source.readEnum<ForegroundClass>(),
            )
            val reports = if (schema >= 2) {
                List(source.readBoundedCount("usage reports", RestrictionEngine.MAX_REPORT_DAYS)) {
                    val localDayKey = source.readUTF()
                    val protectedUsageMs = source.readLong()
                    source.readLong() // Retired protection-off usage is deliberately discarded.
                    val exerciseSets = if (schema >= 5) source.readLong() else 0L
                    DailyUsageReport(
                        localDayKey = localDayKey,
                        protectedUsageMs = protectedUsageMs,
                        offUsageMs = 0,
                        exerciseSets = exerciseSets,
                    )
                }
            } else emptyList()
            val reminder = if (schema >= 2) {
                OffUsageReminderState(
                    sessionStartedAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                    qualifyingUsageMs = source.readLong(),
                    firstNotificationSent = source.readBoolean(),
                    lastNotificationWallMs = source.readLong(),
                    usageAtLastNotificationMs = source.readLong(),
                )
            } else OffUsageReminderState()
            val currentVisitGraceActive = if (schema == 2) {
                try {
                    source.readBoolean()
                } catch (_: EOFException) {
                    // Early schema-v2 development builds ended after the reminder state.
                    false
                }
            } else if (schema >= 3) {
                source.readBoolean()
            } else false
            val activityEvents = if (schema >= 6) {
                List(source.readBoundedCount("activity events", RestrictionEngine.MAX_ACTIVITY_EVENTS)) {
                    ActivityEvent(
                        id = source.readUTF(),
                        localDayKey = source.readUTF(),
                        type = source.readEnum<ActivityEventType>(),
                        startedAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                        endedAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                        valueMs = source.readLong(),
                    )
                }
            } else emptyList()
            val monthlyPushupCycles = if (schema >= 9) {
                List(source.readBoundedCount("monthly cycles", 10_000)) {
                    MonthlyPushupCycle(
                        cycleStartDate = source.readUTF(),
                        totalPushups = source.readLong(),
                    )
                }
            } else emptyList()
            val lastExercise = if (schema >= 13 && source.readBoolean()) ExerciseReceipt(
                id = source.readUTF(), dayKey = source.readUTF(), recordedAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                originalExercise = source.readEnum<ExerciseId>(), originalValue = source.readLong(),
                exercise = source.readEnum<ExerciseId>(), value = source.readLong(),
                pointsBefore = source.readLong(), awardedSets = source.readLong(),
                eveningResetApplied = source.readBoolean(), flagged = source.readBoolean(),
                corrected = source.readBoolean(),
            ) else null
            val correctionHistory = if (schema >= 14) {
                // The count is untrusted: reject negatives, then decode incrementally so a
                // corrupt large count fails on EOF instead of preallocating a huge list.
                val count = source.readBoundedCount("correction events", Int.MAX_VALUE)
                val events = ArrayList<CorrectionEvent>()
                repeat(count) {
                    events += CorrectionEvent(
                        id = source.readUTF(),
                        receiptId = source.readUTF(),
                        correctedAtWallMs = source.readLong(),
                        originalType = source.readUTF(),
                        originalValue = source.readLong(),
                        correctedType = source.readUTF(),
                        correctedValue = source.readLong(),
                    )
                }
                events
            } else emptyList()
            val state = PersistedState(
                lastExercise = lastExercise,
                correctionHistory = correctionHistory,
                schemaVersion = RESTRICTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                stateRevision = revision,
                settings = settings,
                dailyUsage = daily,
                activeUnlock = unlock,
                pendingWait = pending,
                dailyCounter = counter,
                runtimeMetadata = metadata,
                usageReports = reports,
                activityEvents = activityEvents,
                monthlyPushupCycles = monthlyPushupCycles,
                offUsageReminder = reminder,
                currentVisitGraceActive = currentVisitGraceActive,
            )
            validate(state)
            return state
        } catch (error: CorruptionException) {
            throw error
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            throw CorruptionException("State could not be read", error)
        }
    }

    override suspend fun writeTo(t: PersistedState, output: OutputStream) {
        validate(t)
        val target = DataOutputStream(output)
        target.writeInt(MAGIC)
        target.writeInt(RESTRICTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION)
        target.writeLong(t.stateRevision)
        with(t.settings) {
            target.writeBoolean(enforcementEnabled)
            target.writeBoolean(pauseUntilWallMs != null)
            pauseUntilWallMs?.let(target::writeLong)
            target.writeBoolean(true) // Keep the stable slot while the wait toggle is retired.
            target.writeBoolean(emergencySkipsEnabled)
            target.writeLong(emergencySkipDailyLimit)
            target.writeInt(theme.ordinal)
            target.writeBoolean(onboardingCompleted)
            target.writeInt(sessionMinutes.size)
            sessionMinutes.forEach(target::writeLong)
        }
        target.writeUsage(t.dailyUsage)
        target.writeBoolean(t.activeUnlock != null)
        t.activeUnlock?.let {
            target.writeUTF(it.id)
            target.writeInt(it.source.ordinal)
            target.writeLong(it.grantedAtWallMs)
            target.writeLong(it.expiresAtWallMs)
        }
        target.writeBoolean(t.pendingWait != null)
        t.pendingWait?.let {
            target.writeUTF(it.id)
            target.writeLong(it.selectedDurationMs)
            target.writeLong(it.requiredFocusMs)
            target.writeLong(it.accumulatedFocusMs)
            target.writeLong(it.createdAtWallMs)
            target.writeLong(it.updatedAtWallMs)
        }
        with(t.dailyCounter) {
            target.writeUTF(localDayKey)
            target.writeLong(earnedBudgetRounds)
            target.writeLong(emergencySkipsUsed)
            target.writeLong(pushupRepetitionRemainder)
            target.writeLong(spendableBudgetRounds)
            target.writeBoolean(eveningResetApplied)
            target.writeLong(verifiedPushups)
            target.writeLong(plankSecondRemainder)
            target.writeLong(machineRepetitionRemainder)
            target.writeInt(creditedExerciseVerificationIds.size)
            creditedExerciseVerificationIds.forEach(target::writeUTF)
            target.writeLong(exercisePointSixths)
            target.writeLong(sprintMetersRemainder)
        }
        with(t.runtimeMetadata) {
            target.writeLong(lastCommittedWallMs)
            target.writeUTF(recoveryEpochId)
            target.writeLong(serviceLastConnectedWallMs)
            target.writeInt(lastKnownForegroundClass.ordinal)
        }
        target.writeInt(t.usageReports.size)
        t.usageReports.forEach {
            target.writeUTF(it.localDayKey)
            target.writeLong(it.protectedUsageMs)
            target.writeLong(0L) // Keep the stable slot while protection-off history is retired.
            target.writeLong(it.exerciseSets)
        }
        with(t.offUsageReminder) {
            target.writeLong(sessionStartedAtWallMs)
            target.writeLong(qualifyingUsageMs)
            target.writeBoolean(firstNotificationSent)
            target.writeLong(lastNotificationWallMs)
            target.writeLong(usageAtLastNotificationMs)
        }
        target.writeBoolean(t.currentVisitGraceActive)
        target.writeInt(t.activityEvents.size)
        t.activityEvents.forEach { event ->
            target.writeUTF(event.id)
            target.writeUTF(event.localDayKey)
            target.writeInt(event.type.ordinal)
            target.writeLong(event.startedAtWallMs)
            target.writeLong(event.endedAtWallMs)
            target.writeLong(event.valueMs)
        }
        target.writeInt(t.monthlyPushupCycles.size)
        t.monthlyPushupCycles.forEach { cycle ->
            target.writeUTF(cycle.cycleStartDate)
            target.writeLong(cycle.totalPushups)
        }
        target.writeBoolean(t.lastExercise != null)
        t.lastExercise?.let {
            target.writeUTF(it.id)
            target.writeUTF(it.dayKey)
            target.writeLong(it.recordedAtWallMs)
            target.writeInt(it.originalExercise.ordinal)
            target.writeLong(it.originalValue)
            target.writeInt(it.exercise.ordinal)
            target.writeLong(it.value)
            target.writeLong(it.pointsBefore)
            target.writeLong(it.awardedSets)
            target.writeBoolean(it.eveningResetApplied)
            target.writeBoolean(it.flagged)
            target.writeBoolean(it.corrected)
        }
        target.writeInt(t.correctionHistory.size)
        t.correctionHistory.forEach {
            target.writeUTF(it.id)
            target.writeUTF(it.receiptId)
            target.writeLong(it.correctedAtWallMs)
            target.writeUTF(it.originalType)
            target.writeLong(it.originalValue)
            target.writeUTF(it.correctedType)
            target.writeLong(it.correctedValue)
        }
        target.flush()
    }

    private fun validate(state: PersistedState) {
        fun invalid(message: String): Nothing = throw CorruptionException(message)
        if (state.schemaVersion != RESTRICTOR_SCHEMA_VERSION) invalid("Wrong schema")
        state.lastExercise?.let {
            if (it.id.isBlank() || it.id.length > 128 || it.dayKey.isBlank() || it.recordedAtWallMs < 0 ||
                it.originalValue <= 0 || it.value < 0 ||
                ExercisePolicies.find(it.originalExercise)?.credited != true ||
                ExercisePolicies.find(it.exercise)?.credited != true ||
                it.pointsBefore !in 0 until EXERCISE_POINT_SIXTHS_PER_BOOST ||
                it.awardedSets !in 0..MAX_SAFE_BUDGET_ROUNDS) invalid("Invalid exercise receipt")
        }
        if (state.stateRevision < 0) invalid("Negative revision")
        if (!state.settings.enforcementEnabled || state.settings.pauseUntilWallMs != null) {
            invalid("Protection must remain enabled")
        }
        if (!state.settings.emergencySkipsEnabled) invalid("Emergency skips must remain enabled")
        if (!state.settings.delayEnabled) invalid("The focused wait must remain enabled")
        if (state.settings.emergencySkipDailyLimit != EMERGENCY_SKIP_DAILY_LIMIT) {
            invalid("Invalid setting value")
        }
        if (
            state.settings.sessionMinutes.size != DEFAULT_SESSION_MINUTES.size ||
            state.settings.sessionMinutes.any { it !in MIN_SESSION_MINUTES..MAX_SESSION_MINUTES }
        ) invalid("Invalid session presets")
        if (state.dailyUsage.usedMs < 0) invalid("Negative usage")
        state.activeUnlock?.let {
            if (it.id.isBlank() || it.grantedAtWallMs < 0 || it.expiresAtWallMs < it.grantedAtWallMs) {
                invalid("Invalid unlock")
            }
        }
        state.pendingWait?.let {
            if (
                it.id.isBlank() || it.selectedDurationMs <= 0 || it.requiredFocusMs < 0 ||
                it.accumulatedFocusMs !in 0..it.requiredFocusMs || it.createdAtWallMs < 0 ||
                it.updatedAtWallMs < it.createdAtWallMs
            ) invalid("Invalid pending wait")
        }
        if (state.activeUnlock != null && state.pendingWait != null) invalid("Unlock and wait overlap")
        if (
            state.dailyCounter.exercisePointSixths !in 0 until EXERCISE_POINT_SIXTHS_PER_BOOST ||
            state.dailyCounter.earnedBudgetRounds !in 0..MAX_SAFE_BUDGET_ROUNDS ||
            state.dailyCounter.spendableBudgetRounds !in 0..state.dailyCounter.earnedBudgetRounds ||
            state.dailyCounter.emergencySkipsUsed < 0 ||
            // These three retired fields retain their historical schema bounds.
            state.dailyCounter.pushupRepetitionRemainder !in 0 until 5L ||
            // Older installs can carry 15–17 seconds from the former 18-second set.
            // Preserve these until the next verified plank folds them into credit.
            state.dailyCounter.plankSecondRemainder !in 0 until 18L ||
            state.dailyCounter.machineRepetitionRemainder !in 0 until 10L ||
            state.dailyCounter.sprintMetersRemainder !in 0 until SPRINT_SET_QUALIFYING_METERS ||
            state.dailyCounter.verifiedPushups < 0 ||
            state.dailyCounter.creditedExerciseVerificationIds.size >
            MAX_DAILY_CREDITED_EXERCISE_VERIFICATIONS ||
            state.dailyCounter.creditedExerciseVerificationIds.any {
                it.isBlank() || it.length > 128
            } ||
            state.dailyCounter.creditedExerciseVerificationIds.distinct().size !=
            state.dailyCounter.creditedExerciseVerificationIds.size
        ) {
            invalid("Invalid daily counter")
        }
        if (state.usageReports.size > RestrictionEngine.MAX_REPORT_DAYS) invalid("Too many report days")
        state.usageReports.forEach {
            if (
                it.localDayKey.isBlank() || it.protectedUsageMs < 0 || it.offUsageMs != 0L ||
                it.exerciseSets < 0
            ) {
                invalid("Invalid usage report")
            }
        }
        if (state.activityEvents.size > RestrictionEngine.MAX_ACTIVITY_EVENTS) {
            invalid("Too many activity events")
        }
        state.activityEvents.forEach { event ->
            if (
                event.id.isBlank() || event.localDayKey.isBlank() || event.startedAtWallMs < 0 ||
                event.endedAtWallMs < event.startedAtWallMs || event.valueMs < 0
            ) {
                invalid("Invalid activity event")
            }
        }
        state.correctionHistory.forEach {
            if (
                it.id.isBlank() || it.id.length > 128 ||
                it.receiptId.isBlank() || it.receiptId.length > 128 ||
                it.correctedAtWallMs < 0 ||
                it.originalType.isBlank() || it.originalType.length > 128 ||
                it.correctedType.isBlank() || it.correctedType.length > 128 ||
                it.originalValue <= 0 || it.correctedValue < 0
            ) invalid("Invalid correction event")
        }
        if (state.monthlyPushupCycles.size > 10_000) invalid("Too many monthly cycles")
        var previousCycleStart: String? = null
        state.monthlyPushupCycles.forEach { cycle ->
            val parsedStart = runCatching { java.time.LocalDate.parse(cycle.cycleStartDate) }.getOrNull()
                ?: invalid("Invalid monthly push-up cycle date")
            if (
                parsedStart.dayOfMonth != 9 || cycle.totalPushups < 0 ||
                previousCycleStart?.let { it >= cycle.cycleStartDate } == true
            ) {
                invalid("Invalid monthly push-up cycle")
            }
            previousCycleStart = cycle.cycleStartDate
        }
        with(state.offUsageReminder) {
            if (
                sessionStartedAtWallMs < 0 || qualifyingUsageMs < 0 || lastNotificationWallMs < 0 ||
                usageAtLastNotificationMs < 0 || usageAtLastNotificationMs > qualifyingUsageMs
            ) invalid("Invalid reminder state")
        }
    }

    private fun DataOutputStream.writeUsage(usage: UsagePeriodState) {
        writeUTF(usage.key)
        writeLong(usage.usedMs)
    }

    private fun DataInputStream.readUsage(period: BudgetPeriod) = UsagePeriodState(
        period = period,
        key = readUTF(),
        usedMs = readLong(),
    )

    private inline fun <reified T : Enum<T>> DataInputStream.readEnum(): T {
        val values = enumValues<T>()
        val ordinal = readInt()
        if (ordinal !in values.indices) throw CorruptionException("Invalid enum value")
        return values[ordinal]
    }
}

private fun DataInputStream.readBoundedCount(label: String, maximum: Int): Int = readInt().also {
    if (it !in 0..maximum) throw CorruptionException("Invalid $label count")
}

    @Test
    fun correctionHistoryWritesAtomicallyWithTheCorrectedReceipt() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")
        val now = java.time.ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 9, 14, 12, 0, 0, 0, zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(now, 1000L, zone)
        val store = FailingRewardStore(PersistedState())
        val repo = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)
        repo.awaitLoaded()
        repo.recordVerifiedExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 1)
        store.fail = true
        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure,
            repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5))
        // A failed write publishes neither the history event nor the correction.
        assertTrue(store.data.first().correctionHistory.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(store.data.first().lastExercise!!.corrected)
        store.fail = false
        // A successful retry records exactly one event.
        assertTrue(repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val event = store.data.first().correctionHistory.single()
        assertEquals("positive", event.receiptId)
        assertEquals(now, event.correctedAtWallMs)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.originalType)
        assertEquals(1L, event.originalValue)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.correctedType)
        assertEquals(5L, event.correctedValue)
        // Re-saving the same value is a no-op for history.
        repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
        assertEquals(1, store.data.first().correctionHistory.size)

private class InMemoryDataStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val flow = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = flow
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (t: PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        val next = transform(flow.value)
        flow.value = next
        return next
    }
}

private class FailingRewardStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val state = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    var fail = false
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = state
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        if (fail) throw java.io.IOException("Disk full")
        return transform(state.value).also { state.value = it }
    }
}

private class InMemoryDataStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val flow = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = flow
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (t: PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        val next = transform(flow.value)
        flow.value = next
        return next
    }
}

private class FailingRewardStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val state = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    var fail = false
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = state
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        if (fail) throw java.io.IOException("Disk full")
        return transform(state.value).also { state.value = it }
    }
}

    @Test

        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")

        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(now, 1_000L, zone)
        val engine = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RestrictionEngine()
        val earned = (engine.recordSprintRecording(PersistedState(), "budget", 600L, false, now, zone)
            as com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.CommandResult.Applied).state
        val initial = earned.copy(activeUnlock = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.UnlockSession(
            "normal", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.UnlockSource.NORMAL, now, now + 600_000L))
        val repo = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = FailingRewardStore(initial))
        repo.awaitLoaded()
        repo.updateDeviceAccess(true, true, true, true)
        repo.updateServiceRuntime(foregroundClass = ForegroundClass.BROWSER,
            activeTarget = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ProtectedTarget.BROWSER_POOL,
            screenInteractive = true, keyguardUnlocked = true, serviceConnected = true)
        time.advance(250L)
        repo.tick(time.elapsedMs, time.wallMs)
        time.advance(250L)
        time.wallMs += 60_000L
        repo.tick(time.elapsedMs, time.wallMs)
        time.advance(250L)
        repo.flushAccounting()
        assertEquals(750L, repo.snapshot.value.todayUsageReport.protectedUsageMs)
        assertEquals(750L, repo.snapshot.value.budgetSnapshots.single().usedMs)
    }

    @Test

        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")
        val before = java.time.ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 7, 10, 3, 59, 59, 0, zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(before, 1_000L, zone)

        repo.awaitLoaded()
        store.fail = true
        val failed = repo.recordSprintRecording("retry-receipt", 150L)
        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure, failed)
        assertEquals(5L, repo.snapshot.value.earnedBudgetRoundsToday)
        store.fail = false
        time.advance(2_000L)
        val saved = repo.recordSprintRecording("retry-receipt", 150L)
            as com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved
        assertEquals(1L, saved.commit.awardedSets)
        assertEquals(30L, saved.commit.remainder)
        assertEquals("2026-07-10", saved.commit.dayKey)
        org.junit.Assert.assertTrue(repo.recordSprintRecording("retry-receipt", 150L)

        assertEquals(1L, repo.snapshot.value.earnedBudgetRoundsToday)
        store.fail = true
        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure,
            repo.recordVerifiedExercise("video-retry", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 7))

        val video = repo.recordVerifiedExercise("video-retry", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 7)

        assertEquals(12L, video.commit.remainder)

private class InMemoryDataStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val flow = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = flow
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (t: PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        val next = transform(flow.value)
        flow.value = next
        return next
    }
}

private class FailingRewardStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val state = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    var fail = false
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = state
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        if (fail) throw java.io.IOException("Disk full")
        return transform(state.value).also { state.value = it }
    }
}

        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")

            repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5))
        // A failed write publishes neither the history event nor the correction.
        assertTrue(store.data.first().correctionHistory.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(store.data.first().lastExercise!!.corrected)
        store.fail = false
        // A successful retry records exactly one event.
        assertTrue(repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val event = store.data.first().correctionHistory.single()
        assertEquals("positive", event.receiptId)
        assertEquals(now, event.correctedAtWallMs)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.originalType)
        assertEquals(1L, event.originalValue)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.correctedType)
        assertEquals(5L, event.correctedValue)
        // Re-saving the same value is a no-op for history.
        repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
        assertEquals(1, store.data.first().correctionHistory.size)

        val reloaded = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,

private class InMemoryDataStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val flow = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = flow
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (t: PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        val next = transform(flow.value)
        flow.value = next
        return next
    }
}

    private val state = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    var fail = false
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = state
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        if (fail) throw java.io.IOException("Disk full")
        return transform(state.value).also { state.value = it }
    }
}

    @Test
    fun correctionWriteFailureKeepsOriginalAndRetryUpdatesOnce() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {

    @Test
    fun correctionHistoryWritesAtomicallyWithTheCorrectedReceipt() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")
        val now = java.time.ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 9, 14, 12, 0, 0, 0, zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(now, 1000L, zone)
        val store = FailingRewardStore(PersistedState())
        val repo = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)
        repo.awaitLoaded()
        repo.recordVerifiedExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 1)
        store.fail = true
        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure,
            repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5))
        // A failed write publishes neither the history event nor the correction.
        assertTrue(store.data.first().correctionHistory.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(store.data.first().lastExercise!!.corrected)
        store.fail = false
        // A successful retry records exactly one event.
        assertTrue(repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val event = store.data.first().correctionHistory.single()
        assertEquals("positive", event.receiptId)
        assertEquals(now, event.correctedAtWallMs)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.originalType)
        assertEquals(1L, event.originalValue)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.correctedType)
        assertEquals(5L, event.correctedValue)
        // Re-saving the same value is a no-op for history.
        repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
        assertEquals(1, store.data.first().correctionHistory.size)

            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)

            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val persisted = store.data.first()
        assertEquals(2, persisted.correctionHistory.size)
        assertEquals("plank", persisted.correctionHistory[1].correctedType)

    }

private class InMemoryDataStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val flow = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = flow
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (t: PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        val next = transform(flow.value)
        flow.value = next
        return next
    }
}

private class FailingRewardStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val state = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    var fail = false
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = state
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        if (fail) throw java.io.IOException("Disk full")
        return transform(state.value).also { state.value = it }
    }
}

package com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.data

import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ForegroundClass
import com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.PendingWait

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals

import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RestrictorRepositoryPolicyTest {
    @Test
    fun correctionWriteFailureKeepsOriginalAndRetryUpdatesOnce() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")
        val now = java.time.ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 9, 14, 12, 0, 0, 0, zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(now, 1000L, zone)
        val store = FailingRewardStore(PersistedState())
        val repo = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)
        repo.awaitLoaded()
        repo.recordVerifiedExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 1)
        store.fail = true
        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure,
            repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5))
        assertEquals(1L, repo.snapshot.value.lastExercise!!.value)
        assertEquals(0L, repo.snapshot.value.earnedBudgetRoundsToday)
        store.fail = false
        repeat(2) { repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5) }
        assertEquals(5L, repo.snapshot.value.lastExercise!!.value)
        assertEquals(1L, repo.snapshot.value.earnedBudgetRoundsToday)
        org.junit.Assert.assertTrue(repo.correctExercise("unknown", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Rejected)
    }

    @Test
    fun correctionHistoryWritesAtomicallyWithTheCorrectedReceipt() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
        val zone = java.time.ZoneId.of("UTC")
        val now = java.time.ZonedDateTime.of(2026, 9, 14, 12, 0, 0, 0, zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(now, 1000L, zone)
        val store = FailingRewardStore(PersistedState())
        val repo = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)
        repo.awaitLoaded()
        repo.recordVerifiedExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 1)
        store.fail = true
        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure,
            repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5))
        // A failed write publishes neither the history event nor the correction.
        assertTrue(store.data.first().correctionHistory.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(store.data.first().lastExercise!!.corrected)
        store.fail = false
        // A successful retry records exactly one event.
        assertTrue(repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val event = store.data.first().correctionHistory.single()
        assertEquals("positive", event.receiptId)
        assertEquals(now, event.correctedAtWallMs)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.originalType)
        assertEquals(1L, event.originalValue)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.correctedType)
        assertEquals(5L, event.correctedValue)
        // Re-saving the same value is a no-op for history.
        repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
        assertEquals(1, store.data.first().correctionHistory.size)
        // History survives a restart: a new repository on the same store loads and appends.
        val reloaded = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)
        reloaded.awaitLoaded()
        assertTrue(reloaded.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PLANK, 7)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val persisted = store.data.first()
        assertEquals(2, persisted.correctionHistory.size)
        assertEquals("plank", persisted.correctionHistory[1].correctedType)
        assertEquals(7L, persisted.correctionHistory[1].correctedValue)
    }

private class InMemoryDataStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val flow = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = flow
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (t: PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        val next = transform(flow.value)
        flow.value = next
        return next
    }
}

private class FailingRewardStore(initial: PersistedState) : androidx.datastore.core.DataStore<PersistedState> {
    private val state = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(initial)
    var fail = false
    override val data: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<PersistedState> = state
    override suspend fun updateData(transform: suspend (PersistedState) -> PersistedState): PersistedState {
        if (fail) throw java.io.IOException("Disk full")
        return transform(state.value).also { state.value = it }
    }
}

        val time = com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.FakeTimeSource(now, 1000L, zone)
        val store = FailingRewardStore(PersistedState())
        val repo = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,

        assertEquals(com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.StorageFailure,

        // A failed write publishes neither the history event nor the correction.
        assertTrue(store.data.first().correctionHistory.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(store.data.first().lastExercise!!.corrected)
        store.fail = false
        // A successful retry records exactly one event.
        assertTrue(repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
            is com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.RewardSaveResult.Saved)
        val event = store.data.first().correctionHistory.single()
        assertEquals("positive", event.receiptId)
        assertEquals(now, event.correctedAtWallMs)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.originalType)
        assertEquals(1L, event.originalValue)
        assertEquals("push_up", event.correctedType)
        assertEquals(5L, event.correctedValue)
        // Re-saving the same value is a no-op for history.
        repo.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PUSH_UP, 5)
        assertEquals(1, store.data.first().correctionHistory.size)
        // History survives a restart: a new repository on the same store loads and appends.
        val reloaded = RestrictorRepository(timeSource = time,
            applicationScope = kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            dataStoreOverride = store)
        reloaded.awaitLoaded()
        assertTrue(reloaded.correctExercise("positive", com.michalkrsik.internetrestrictor.domain.ExerciseId.PLANK, 7)

        val persisted = store.data.first()
        assertEquals(2, persisted.correctionHistory.size)

        assertEquals(7L, persisted.correctionHistory[1].correctedValue)
    }

atomically replace its contribution to shared points, earned/spendable rounds,

Schema 14 appends a permanent local correction history to the same state
transaction. Every saved edit that actually changes the count or the exercise type
appends an immutable entry recording the correction time in epoch milliseconds,
the receipt's verification ID, the immutable reviewer count and type, and the
corrected count and type. Both types are stored as stable wire strings (exercise
IDs today) so other validation kinds can reuse the entry later. Re-saving
identical values and flag-only marks add no entry. The history survives restarts,
newer recordings, both daily resets, and report-history clearing with no age or
count truncation; only deleting the app's data or uninstalling removes it. There
is no online sync, export, or history UI yet.

# Project documentation

## Source map

- `app/src/main/`: maintained Android app and product behavior.
- `app/src/test/` and `app/src/androidTest/`: Android regression and device tests.
- `server/src/` and `server/test/`: maintained video verifier and its tests.
- `app/src/main/java/com/michalkrsik/internetrestrictor/domain/Exercise.kt`: authoritative exercise weights; display set sizes derive from them.
- `app/src/main/java/com/michalkrsik/internetrestrictor/domain/RestrictionEngine.kt`: reward application and restriction rules.
- `design-preview/`: historical React design mockup; not the shipped Android UI.
- `prototypes/`: historical experiments; not maintained product code.
- `validation_artifacts/` and `review-reports/`: historical captures and review evidence.

## Challenge reliability and limits

Verified camera measurements and sprint results retain their receipt until saving succeeds;
"Retry saving" reuses that receipt without another recording or model call. The reward
transaction returns its awarded sets, remainder, and day, so crossing 04:00 does not
require the UI to infer the award from changing daily totals. Sprint session state lives
in the foreground service; camera verification and pending credit live in a retained
ViewModel. These preserve progress across Activity recreation within the running app.

Sprints stop automatically after 15 minutes and retain their evaluated result. Leaving
or starting over with unsaved sprint progress requires a discard confirmation. Missing
GPS coverage at the beginning of a recording counts toward the reliability fallback.
Permanent location denial routes the user to the app's system settings.

Normal session presets remain maximum wall-clock windows subject to the available
budget. An exhausted normal session can be replaced by an earned emergency skip.
Monthly push-up cycles follow the device timezone, like the daily accounting periods.

The verifier uses one playback densification factor for preprocessing and plank timing.
Plank output is converted to original seconds on the server. Results exceeding the clip's
length (holds) or three repetitions per original second are rejected as implausible.
The client permits 240 seconds for a response, retries explicit busy responses according
to Retry-After, and disconnects cancelled requests; the server cancels its active work
when that client connection closes.

## Personal notes and future ideas

Personal notes and future ideas belong in `Dev/` at the project root, as individual
`.md` files. Preserve that folder and its contents during cleanup. Do not delete,
move, rename, or consolidate those notes into `DOCUMENTATION.md` or other
operational documentation unless the user explicitly asks to change those notes.
An idea saved there is for later work; saving it does not authorize implementation.

This is the central reference for building, operating, and developing Internet
Restrictor. The [README](README.md) describes the current product; license notices
remain in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Production setup

The Android app sends exercise recordings to the dedicated Railway verifier,
which processes the video with FFmpeg and calls OpenRouter. Railway is the only
production hosting dependency for this app; there is no separate server to maintain.

| Setting | Current value |
| --- | --- |
| Railway project | [browser-restrictor](https://railway.com/project/da2c70e8-6f57-47a5-bab2-d697888abbae) |
| Service / environment | `exercise-verifier` / `production` |
| Service ID | `999755bc-8c57-4fd1-8130-90f0a8106b89` |
| Environment ID | `558bca8f-abd7-4e06-bd56-9a0acddf275e` |
| Region | `europe-west4-drams3a`, one replica |
| Verification endpoint | `https://exercise-verifier-production.up.railway.app/v1/exercise-verify` |
| Health endpoint | `https://exercise-verifier-production.up.railway.app/health` |
| Model | `google/gemini-3.8-flash` |
| Infrastructure definition | `.railway/railway.ts` |

The public verifier address is tracked in `gradle.properties`. The matching
`VERIFY_SHARED_SECRET` is configured in Railway and GitHub repository secrets;
local builds use `verifySharedSecret` in the ignored `local.properties` or the
environment. `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is configured in Railway.

### Why the build now requires verifier settings

A previous APK built on a new computer had empty verifier settings and could not
start exercise recording. Packaging now fails when the URL or shared secret is
missing. GitHub's build supplies the saved settings and signing key, so a new
computer does not need to reproduce the local setup to obtain an installable APK.

### Verified baseline — 2026-09-06

- 112 Android unit tests, Android test compilation, lint, and APK assembly passed.
- All 14 server tests passed locally and during the container build.
- Live health and unauthenticated-upload rejection checks passed.
- A synthetic MP4 passed through HTTPS upload, FFmpeg, and OpenRouter and returned
  `unsupported` with zero credit.
- The [cloud build](https://github.com/bald-ai/browser_restrictor_android/actions/runs/34048306333)
  passed; its downloaded APK matched the local signing certificate and verifier settings.
- Physical camera recording and actual pushup counting still need a phone check.

## Requirements

- Android Studio or another Android toolchain with JDK 17.
- Android SDK Platform 36 and Build Tools installed.
- An Android 10 (API 29) or newer device.
- At least one shared-pool app installed: stable Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera, or X.

The project uses Gradle 8.14.5, Android Gradle Plugin 8.13.2, Kotlin 2.3.20, Jetpack Compose BOM 2026.06.00, and DataStore 1.2.1.

## Build

From this directory:

```bash
./gradlew assembleDebug
```

The verifier address is checked into `gradle.properties`, so every checkout uses
the Railway service. For a local build, the ignored `local.properties` supplies
the shared verifier secret:

```properties
verifySharedSecret=your-shared-secret
```

Alternatively, supply `verifyUrl` and `verifySharedSecret` as Gradle properties,
or use the `VERIFY_URL` and `VERIFY_SHARED_SECRET` environment variables.
Gradle properties take precedence over `local.properties`, then environment variables.
APK and bundle packaging fails if either setting is missing, because that build
would disable exercise recording. Compilation and unit tests still run without
verifier settings.

The **Build Android APK** GitHub Actions workflow builds an installable APK
using the repository secrets `VERIFY_SHARED_SECRET` and
`ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64`. The latter preserves the signing key between
builds, allowing updates without uninstalling the app. The workflow explicitly
selects the restored key through `ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PATH` and checks the
packaged APK certificate before publishing it. Local builds use the Android
toolchain's default debug key unless that environment variable is supplied. Download the
`internet-restrictor-android` artifact from the successful workflow run.

The debug APK is written to:

```text
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

Install it on a connected device with:

```bash
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

## Android app identity

This green-icon browser gate is installed as
`com.michalkrsik.browserrestrictor`. That ID is intentionally different from
the Calculator/GPS Internet Restrictor prototype, so both can be installed on
the same phone. Before installing an APK, use the Android SDK's `aapt dump badging`
to confirm that its embedded package is `com.michalkrsik.browserrestrictor`.
The GitHub build performs this check before publishing its artifact.

## Device setup

1. Open **Internet Restrictor** and continue through onboarding.
2. On the Accessibility step, open Android's Accessibility settings and enable **Internet Restrictor — Protect browsers**.
3. On Android 13 or newer, a sideloaded APK may initially block that switch. Open the app's **App info**, use the three-dot menu, choose **Allow restricted settings**, and then return to Accessibility.
4. Usage Access is optional for the current personal MVP. Granting it prepares the permission path, but the app still truthfully reports **Protected with limited recovery** until history reconciliation is validated.
5. Use **Test browser gate**. The browser may draw one brief frame before Android reports the foreground change; the gate should then cover it and block its touches.

After setup, changing the Accessibility or Usage Access switch in Android settings is reflected in the dashboard health card.

## Verification

Run the complete local verification suite with:

```bash
./gradlew clean testDebugUnitTest :app:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin lintDebug assembleDebug
```

The unit suite covers local-day and Monday-to-Sunday week boundaries, fixed waits, gate priority, unlocks, earned budget, active-use accounting, persisted exercise sets, budget exhaustion, stale commands, latches, corruption detection, and persistence round trips. Compose gate tests are also compiled as part of the command.

To run the Compose instrumentation tests on a connected emulator or device:

```bash
./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest
```

The captures in `validation_artifacts/` predate this redesign and are retained only as a baseline. They are not current visual proof of the daily-only earned-budget flow.

## Architecture

- `domain/`: pure restriction engine, local-day math, fixed wait rules, and immutable state models.
- `data/`: serialized repository mutations and a typed binary DataStore serializer.
- `monitoring/`: protected-target foreground classification, Accessibility service, permissions, and device health.
- `overlay/`: full-screen gate and compact session badge window controllers.
- `ui/`: onboarding, dashboard, settings, gate, badge, reusable components, and theme.
- `diagnostics/`: bounded, local-only operational events that can be copied from the app.
- `receivers/`: boot and wall-clock boundary recovery signals.
- `server/`: the ffmpeg-backed exercise verifier. It accepts one authenticated MP4 upload up to 75 MB and 30 seconds, stretches four source frames per second from the complete clip into Gemini's one-frame-per-playback-second sampling path, and classifies the clip with a typed result. The legacy push-up endpoint remains supported. See [the exercise-verification contract](#exercise-verification-contract).

The Accessibility service reacts only to window-level changes. It uses the active window package name to distinguish supported browsers, X, YouTube, Internet Restrictor, and other apps. It does not traverse the accessibility tree or read URLs, webpage text, form fields, typing, or screenshots.

## Important boundaries

- The shared browser pool contains stable Chrome (`com.android.chrome`), Firefox (`org.mozilla.firefox`), Edge (`com.microsoft.emmx`), Opera (`com.opera.browser`), and X (`com.twitter.android`). Their use is combined into one budget and one active session.
- Other browsers and browser variants are outside the current scope.
- The real-time Accessibility signal is authoritative. Ambiguous gaps are left uncounted instead of being guessed.
- Usage Access history reconciliation is not yet implemented; the current build explicitly labels recovery as limited.
- Accessibility overlays cannot stop a user from disabling the service, force-stopping the app, uninstalling it, or using an unsupported browser.
- Physical-device checks are still required across target OEMs for foreground-event latency, touch blocking, TalkBack behavior, Incognito, Custom Tabs, picture-in-picture, multi-window, lock/unlock, reboot, and aggressive process killing.
- A release build still needs the owner's production signing configuration before distribution.

## Privacy and permissions

The manifest intentionally contains no VPN or general system-overlay permission. It requests only what the product needs:

- Accessibility service binding, granted manually by the user, for foreground detection and the accessibility overlay.
- Usage Access, granted manually and optional in this MVP, for the future bounded recovery path.
- Boot completion, to re-establish local period and time-boundary state.
- Android 16 Advanced Protection status query, to report device compatibility honestly.
- Package visibility for stable Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera, and X.
- Camera and internet access for the explicit exercise recording and owner-operated verification flow.

Challenge videos are temporarily uploaded to the owner's verifier and sent to OpenRouter through a zero-data-retention provider route. The verifier deletes source and processed files after every request and removes stale temporary directories after a crash. Backups are disabled so private usage state does not leave the device through Android backup. Bundled typefaces and their license are documented in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Verification server

### Railway deployment

The `server/` directory is a self-contained Railway service. Its Dockerfile
installs Node.js 22 and FFmpeg, runs the server tests, and starts the verifier.
`.railway/railway.ts` configures a `/health` deployment check and one European replica.
No database or persistent disk is required; uploaded clips are temporary.

Set these service variables in Railway:

- `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`: the owner's OpenRouter API key.
- `VERIFY_SHARED_SECRET`: the same verifier secret supplied to the Android build.

The container listens on `0.0.0.0` and Railway's assigned `PORT`.
The production endpoint is
`https://exercise-verifier-production.up.railway.app/v1/exercise-verify`.
The [Railway project](https://railway.com/project/da2c70e8-6f57-47a5-bab2-d697888abbae)
contains the service `exercise-verifier` in the `production` environment.

Deploy with the Railway CLI from this repository:

```bash
npm ci
npx railway login
npx railway link --project da2c70e8-6f57-47a5-bab2-d697888abbae --environment production --service exercise-verifier
npm run hosting:plan
npm run hosting:apply
npm run hosting:deploy
```

The infrastructure file preserves the credentials already stored in Railway.
The Docker build uses `server/` as its root, while the project-level hosting
settings are applied by `hosting:apply` from the repository root.

### Local server development

The server requires Node.js 22 or newer, `ffmpeg`, and `ffprobe`. Run its tests and start it with:

```bash
cd server
npm test
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... VERIFY_SHARED_SECRET=... npm start
```

Local development defaults to `127.0.0.1:8787`. `VERIFY_HOST` and `VERIFY_PORT`
can override the listening address for development and tests.


### Live verification check

With Node.js 22, FFmpeg, and the matching shared secret in the environment:

```bash
export VERIFY_URL=https://exercise-verifier-production.up.railway.app/v1/exercise-verify
node server/scripts/smoke.mjs
```

The script requires `VERIFY_SHARED_SECRET`; `FFMPEG_PATH` optionally selects the
FFmpeg executable. It checks health and authentication, then makes one paid model
request with a generated test pattern. The expected result is `unsupported` with
zero credit. Its temporary video is deleted afterward.

## Exercise verification contract

The launchable challenge is a picker-less generic recording. The verifier classifies
the clip, and the Android client converts the raw measurement into shared exercise
sets.

### Exercise readiness

| Exercise ID | Measurement | Recording limit | Units per set | Current state |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `push_up` | repetitions | 30 seconds | 5 repetitions | enabled |
| `plank` | continuous hold seconds | 30 seconds | 15 seconds | enabled |
| `outdoor_lat_pulldown` | repetitions | 30 seconds | 10 repetitions | enabled |
| `unsupported` | none | 30 seconds | none | fail-closed classification result |
| `sit_up` | repetitions | 30 seconds | TBD | waiting; classified as unsupported |

Credit is computed only on the client. 1 push-up = 2 machine reps = 3 plank seconds =
1 point. Every 5 combined points earns a 3-minute boost (one set). Fractional points
are stored exactly in sixths and mix across exercises. Any combination of 4 boosts
unlocks YouTube until 04:00. Shared progress survives the 20:00 spendable-budget reset.
Schema 11 preserves and combines legacy surplus once during normalization.
Tapping Start begins a 3-second preparation countdown before the 30-second recording;
leaving the activity cancels that preparation countdown. The first
completed set of the logical day enables the emergency unlock (granting 15 elapsed
minutes of free access without consuming earned budget). Monthly 9th-to-9th
history remains verified push-ups only.

### Verification contract

New clients use `POST /v1/exercise-verify` with one multipart field:

- `video`: one `video/mp4` file up to 75 MB and 30 seconds.

The endpoint does not take an exercise picker. It classifies among `push_up`,
`plank`, `outdoor_lat_pulldown`, and `unsupported`. The successful response is a raw
measurement:

```json
{
  "exercise_id": "plank",
  "metric": "hold_seconds",
  "value": 20,
  "reason": "..."
}
```

Business thresholds stay outside the model prompt. Domain code converts `value` into
earned boosts and combined point progress. `POST /v1/pushup-verify` and its existing
`{is_success, confidence, reason, repetition_count}` response remain supported for the
older push-up clients.

The generic contract deliberately has no confidence field. The classifier must either
return one supported exercise with its raw measurement or return `unsupported`; the
client does not carry an unused confidence signal.

The preprocessor still samples at `MODEL_SAMPLE_FPS=4` using `fps=4,setpts=N/1/TB`.
Video is resized proportionally to a 720-pixel short edge (1280×720 for 16:9
landscape, 720×1280 for portrait), then encoded as H.264 at CRF 23 without audio.
Gemini 3.8 Flash uses medium reasoning with a 16,384-token output allowance,
including reasoning tokens. `/health` exposes these active verification settings.
For planks, the model reports the visually measured densified playback seconds and the
server divides by four and rounds to the nearest original second. Keeping this simple
arithmetic out of the model avoids inconsistent duration conversion. Repetition counts
are not scaled.

### Android boundary

`ExerciseChallengeCatalog` remains the client-facing list of stable IDs, metrics,
recording limits, and set sizes. The camera Activity has no picker: its primary CTA is
Start exercise, and every upload goes to `/v1/exercise-verify`. Sit-ups and other
unrecognized clips fail closed without writing credit.

Schema v11 stores shared progress in integer sixth-points, retaining legacy remainder fields
for one-time conversion, plus a dedicated verified-push-up
counter so plank and machine sets cannot inflate push-up history. Every recording gets
a client-generated verification ID. Crediting the measurement and storing that ID are
one atomic state change, so replaying the same result cannot award credit twice. The
IDs reset with the rest of the logical-day state at 04:00.

### GPS sprint activity

- **Entry points:** Dedicated "Start sprint" action buttons on the Dashboard, GateScreen (Paused, Out of Time), and YouTube locked overlays, completely separate from the camera exercise flow.
- **Recording lifecycle:** Managed by `SprintLocationService`, an Android location foreground service (`FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_LOCATION`) with an ongoing notification and `PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK`. Designed to continue recording while the device screen is locked; physical device verification remains pending.
- **GPS acquisition:** Entry requires both `ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION` and `ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION` permissions (requested together per Android 12+ requirements), enabled GPS provider in system settings, and a fresh satellite fix ($\le 5\text{s}$ old) with horizontal accuracy $\le 25\text{m}$.
- **Movement qualification:**
  - Target sprint distance: 150m; passing set threshold: 120m per earned set.
  - Qualifying average speed: $\ge 15.0\text{ km/h}$ ($\ge 4.167\text{ m/s}$, with $14.95\text{ km/h}$ float tolerance).
  - Running entry: $\ge 3.6\text{ m/s}$ ($13\text{ km/h}$) allows accumulating steps into candidate efforts; walking ($\sim 1.4\text{ m/s}$) or stationary jitter is completely rejected.
  - Speed metric & pace evaluation: Qualification uses time-weighted pace per interval, using reported Doppler speed when present and robust coordinate fallback where absent. Modest coordinate distance undercounts do not discard reliable reported running speeds (accommodated by the 120m threshold). Gross discrepancies between speed and displacement flag GPS as unreliable.
  - Stationary oscillation defense: When speed is absent, small coordinate oscillations within the declared accuracy radius or with near-zero directional progress (<35% net displacement / total distance) are rejected, preventing standing still from generating running credit while preserving clean directional sprints.
  - Spike rejection: At least 2 steps (3 consecutive fixes) and $\ge 1.5\text{s}$ duration are required to qualify an effort, preventing isolated single-point coordinate spikes from accumulating credit.
  - Jump filter: Fixes with implied coordinate speed $> 15\text{ m/s}$ ($54\text{ km/h}$) are rejected as GPS multipath artifacts.
  - Accuracy filter & reliability: Fixes with horizontal accuracy $> 30\text{m}$ are discarded during recording. Unreliable GPS is flagged if $> 60\%$ of fixes are discarded for poor accuracy, if a GPS blackout gap $> 8\text{s}$ occurs, or if no usable fixes arrive in runs $\ge 4\text{s}$.
  - Qualification stability: The longest qualifying prefix $\ge 15.0\text{ km/h}$ is committed and preserved; slowing down (e.g. phone retrieval or jogging to a halt) never revokes already earned qualifying metres or set qualification. Live and final evaluation agree.
  - Vibration: Single 500ms haptic pulse fires at each newly reached set boundary (120m, 240m, etc.).
- **Carryover & persistence (Schema 12):**
  - Unearned qualifying metres carry over across recordings via `DailyCounter.sprintMetersRemainder` (bounds: $0 \dots 119\text{m}$).
  - Remainder resets to 0 at the logical day boundary (04:00) alongside unfinished exercise progress; persists through the 20:00 evening budget reset.
- **Reward semantics:**
  - Every 120m qualifying distance earns 1 set (+3 browser minutes, counts towards 4 sets for YouTube unlock until 04:00, unlocks emergency skip on set 1).
  - Deduplication: `recordingId` is tracked in `creditedExerciseVerificationIds` to prevent duplicate awards.
  - Unreliable GPS fallback: When GPS was unreliable, user can confirm manual completion to receive exactly 1 set (deduplicated, no double crediting).
  - Destination unlock protection: Reopening YouTube from sprint results is blocked unless $\ge 4$ sets have been unlocked today.
  - Asynchronous save safety: `SprintChallengeActivity` captures immutable `SprintSaveState`, disables navigation and back presses during persistence, and only reflects awards upon confirmed storage commit.


### Correcting the latest verified exercise

The review screen and dashboard Last set card offer **Wrong result?** only for a
saved supported exercise whose original verifier value was greater than zero.
Zero, unsupported, and failed reviews do not authorize manual entry. The original
positive measurement is retained even if a later correction reduces the count to zero.
Opening the editor cancels the two-second automatic return; after closing it, the
user continues manually. The editor supports ±1/2/3, an exact whole count, changing
the supported exercise, and a local flag without changing credit.

Schema 13 appends the latest exercise receipt to the existing state format. Edits
atomically replace its contribution to shared points, earned/spendable rounds,
YouTube eligibility, daily reports, activity events, and monthly push-up totals.
Repeated saves of the same count do not add credit. Storage failures retain the
previous result for retry. Older state files migrate without creating an editable
receipt. Corrections are limited to the latest saved camera set in the same budget
period: the 20:00 spendable reset or 04:00 daily reset closes editing, while the
Last set card remains visible. A new positive camera result replaces that card.
